nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) storing token balances; mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spending allowances; decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
Private mapping(address=>uint256) counting sale transfers per address; incremented in transferFrom, read in condition.
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist enabling an address to bypass the ensure() sale conditions.
Private minimum sale amount (scaled by decimals), set in init and read in condition.
Private maximum sale amount (scaled by decimals), set in init and read in condition.
Private maximum number of allowed sales per address, set in init and read in condition.
Address whitelisted in ensure(), set only by setTradeAddress restricted to owner.
Private owner address, set in constructor from msg.sender; gate for privileged functions.
Public total token supply, assigned in constructor.
Public constant decimals = 18, used to scale amounts in _mints and init.
Public token name set in constructor.
Public token symbol set in constructor.
Constant Uniswap router address used as a trusted bypass address in ensure().
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal view whitelist check: owner, UNI/pair address, tradeAddress or canSale bypass; otherwise condition() must hold.
Public payable transferFrom: allowance check, unchecked subtraction, ensure(), unchecked balance updates (-=, +=), sale counter increment, Transfer event.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value unconditionally.
Internal view enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale constraints against _onSaleNum[_from].
Owner-only function performing a.delegatecall(b) on an arbitrary address and data.
Public mint function callable by owner or hard-coded address; sets balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*10**decimals and whitelists canSale[spender].
Owner-only initializer of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch transfer looping over _tos with unchecked total = _value*_tos.length and unchecked balance arithmetic.
Owner-only setter for the trusted tradeAddress used in ensure().
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation via keccak256 create2 formula.
Payable constructor: sets name/symbol, mints totalSupply to msg.sender, sets owner and infinite allowance to router.
Caller-controlled address used for authentication (owner checks) and as transfer source in transfer/approve.
Arbitrary delegatecall in delegate(); target code executes in this contract's storage context, enabling storage corruption and reentrant callbacks.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom without SafeMath; can wrap or overspend if invariants are bypassed.
total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend are unchecked and can overflow/underflow.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom uses raw arithmetic after a >= require.

edges.reason: transfer() forwards msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom.
transferFrom() branches on msg.sender != _from and spends allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using caller-controlled msg.sender.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
delegate() gates execution on require(msg.sender == owner).
_mints() gates minting on msg.sender == owner or a hard-coded address.
init() gates parameter changes on msg.sender == owner.
batchSend() gates mass transfers on msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress() gates the trusted-address update on msg.sender == owner.
transfer() delegates all logic to transferFrom().
transferFrom() calls ensure() to validate whether the transfer is allowed.
ensure() falls back to condition() when no whitelist entry matches.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair address.
ensure() compares _from against the constant UNI router address to bypass checks.
ensure() compares _from against tradeAddress to bypass checks.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to bypass sale conditions.
ensure() compares _from/_to against owner to bypass all restrictions.
ensure() stores the pairFor() result in the local _UNI and compares it to _from.
transferFrom() mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with raw -= and +=.
transferFrom() reads and subtracts allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
transferFrom() increments the per-address sale counter _onSaleNum[_from].
transferFrom() performs the unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value operation.
transferFrom() performs unchecked balance subtraction and addition that can overflow.
The unchecked allowance subtraction writes back into the allowance mapping.
The unchecked balance arithmetic directly rewrites the balanceOf mapping entries.
condition() reads _minSale to bound the minimum transfer amount.
condition() reads _maxSale to bound the maximum transfer amount.
condition() reads _saleNum to cap per-address sale count.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against _saleNum.
_mints() overwrites balanceOf[spender], letting the privileged caller mint arbitrary balances.
_mints() sets canSale[spender] = true, granting a whitelist bypass of ensure().
_mints() scales addedValue by 10**decimals before assigning the balance.
init() writes _minSale from the token parameter.
init() writes _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init() writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
init() multiplies parameters by 10**decimals without SafeMath.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length and subtracts it unchecked.
The unchecked batch arithmetic decrements balanceOf[msg.sender] and increments balanceOf[_to].
batchSend() directly updates balanceOf for the sender and each recipient.
setTradeAddress() writes the trusted tradeAddress consumed by ensure().
constructor sets owner to the deployer.
constructor sets totalSupply from the _supply argument.
constructor writes the token name.
constructor writes the token symbol.
constructor multiplies _supply by 10**decimals to compute totalSupply.
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply.
constructor grants an infinite allowance to the Uniswap router.
delegate() executes a.delegatecall(b), invoking arbitrary external code in this contract's context that can re-enter and mutate shared state.
delegate() passes the caller-supplied target address a into the delegatecall.
delegate() passes the caller-supplied bytes b as delegatecall calldata.
The raw bytes parameter is the calldata payload executed by the low-level delegatecall.
transfer() forwards its _to parameter.
transfer() forwards its _value parameter.
transferFrom() uses the _from parameter as the debited account.
transferFrom() uses the _to parameter as the credited account.
transferFrom() uses the _value parameter for allowance and balance math.
ensure() evaluates the _from parameter against the whitelist.
ensure() evaluates the _to parameter against the whitelist.
ensure() forwards _value into condition().
condition() indexes _onSaleNum with the _from parameter.
condition() compares the _value parameter against _minSale/_maxSale.
_mints() writes the balance of the spender parameter.
_mints() uses addedValue as the minted amount.
init() stores saleNum into _saleNum.
init() stores token into _minSale.
init() stores maxToken into _maxSale.
batchSend() iterates over the _tos recipient array.
batchSend() applies _value per recipient and in the total computation.
setTradeAddress() assigns the addr parameter to tradeAddress.
The local total is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender] inside batchSend().
The local loop index i drives the batchSend() for-loop.
The loop-local _to receives the credited balance inside batchSend().

normalization_plan.reason: _to only exists as the forwarded destination of transfer() and has no independent security meaning.
_value is the forwarded amount of transfer() and resolves into transferFrom().
_from is the debited account in transferFrom() (balanceOf/allowance/_onSaleNum lookups).
_to is the credited account in transferFrom().
_value drives the allowance and balance arithmetic inside transferFrom().
_from is the sole whitelist key evaluated by ensure().
_to is only compared against owner in ensure().
_value is not used by ensure() itself but forwarded to condition() for min/max checks.
_from indexes _onSaleNum inside condition().
_value is bounded by _minSale/_maxSale inside condition().
target address a is consumed by the delegatecall in delegate().
calldata b is consumed by the delegatecall in delegate().
spender is the address whose balance and canSale flag are overwritten in _mints().
addedValue is the minted amount scaled by 10**decimals in _mints().
saleNum is written into the _saleNum sale cap by init().
token is written into _minSale by init().
maxToken is written into _maxSale by init().
_tos determines the loop bound and the recipients credited in batchSend().
_value scales the unchecked total and each credited balance in batchSend().
addr is the new trusted bypass address written to tradeAddress.
local _UNI is the pairFor() result compared against _from inside ensure().
local total is the unchecked product subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender].
loop index i only controls the batchSend() for-loop bound.
loop-local _to is the per-iteration recipient credited in batchSend().
